description:
Secure file server for Windows

CompleteFTP is a high performance Windows file server supporting secure file transfer via FTPS (FTP over SSL), SFTP (FTP over SSH), HTTP, HTTPS, SCP and SSH. CompleteFTP also supports web applications written in Javascript, and collaborative file sharing.
- Add support for ECDSA certificates in FTPS and HTTPS.
- Add support for generation of ECDSA CSRs, and make the default.
- Add Message-ID in email headers.
- Add folder uploads to FM4.
- Fix user quota deadlock bug causing CompleteFTP to not accept new connections.
- Fixed an issue where external HTTP lookups in custom IP-filter scripts could hang without timeouts, preventing the server from accepting incoming connections.
- Fixed an IP Filter startup race condition that could intermittently drop allowed connections.
- Fixed a real-time logging stack overflow in heavily loaded servers.
- Fixed an issue where valid PGP private keys were incorrectly marked as (Invalid key) in CompleteFTP Manager.
- Resolved an error preventing file previews within File Manager 4.
- Fixed another IDP-initiated SAML SSO bug.
- Fixed rendering glitches in the Welcome Message text input box within the Sites configuration panel.
